```yaml
name: Changes Filter

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [main, master]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      has_code_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_code_changes }}
      has_dependency_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_dependency_changes }}
      has_content_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_content_changes }}
      has_seo_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_seo_changes }}
      has_test_changes: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.has_test_changes }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Filter changes
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          filters: |
            has_code_changes:
              - '**/*.ts'
              - '**/*.tsx'
              - '**/*.js'
              - '**/*.jsx'
              - '**/*.json'
              - '!**/*.test.ts'
              - '!**/*.test.tsx'
              - '!**/*.spec.ts'
              - '!**/*.spec.tsx'
            has_dependency_changes:
              - 'package.json'
              - 'package-lock.json'
              - 'yarn.lock'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - '**/package.json'
            has_content_changes:
              - '**/*.md'
              - '**/*.mdx'
              - 'content/**'
              - 'docs/**'
            has_seo_changes:
              - '**/*.md'
              - '**/*.mdx'
              - 'content/**'
              - 'docs/**'
              - 'public/**'
              - 'static/**'
              - '**/robots.txt'
              - '**/sitemap.xml'
            has_test_changes:
              - '**/*.test.ts'
              - '**/*.test.tsx'
              - '**/*.spec.ts'
              - '**/*.spec.tsx'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '__tests__/**'
```
